sections.heading: C2 — Turning merging and passing
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Turning merging and passing

FACT_ID: sec09-R01 | anchor: A03
When passing, use extra care near crossroads and shopping access points where vehicles or pedestrians may enter. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec09-R02 | anchor: A03
Passing on a two-lane road uses the opposing lane and requires judgment to avoid a head-on collision. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec09-R03 | anchor: A03
At 45 mph, the handbook calls for a quarter mile of clear road to pass a slower vehicle safely. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec09-R04 | anchor: A03
The handbook advises traveling about ten mph faster than the vehicle being passed. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec09-R05 | anchor: A03
Before passing several vehicles, identify enough open space ahead of the last one to return safely. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec09-R06 | anchor: A03
Night passing makes distance judgment harder, and oncoming headlights may seem farther away than they are. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec09-R07 | anchor: A03
Passing on the right is allowed on a road with at least two marked traffic lanes in each direction. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec09-R08 | anchor: A03
Do not pass within 100 feet of or across an intersection or railroad crossing unless an official traffic-control device permits it. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec09-R09 | anchor: A03
Do not pass within 100 feet of a bridge, elevated structure or tunnel. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec09-R10 | anchor: A03
Do not pass on or approaching a curve or hillcrest that blocks the view of opposing traffic. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec09-R11 | anchor: A03
Passing on the shoulder of a multilane highway is prohibited. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec09-R12 | anchor: A03
Before passing, check signs and pavement markings for permission and scan for hazards such as entering driveways. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec09-R13 | anchor: A03
Check mirrors and blind spots before passing to ensure another vehicle is not already starting to pass you. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec09-R14 | anchor: A03
Verify that the passing lane is clear and signal the lane change early enough for others to understand. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec09-R15 | anchor: A03
After passing, signal before returning and wait until both headlights of the passed vehicle are visible in the rearview mirror. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0051]
